Instructions to Learners:
1. This question paper consists of 22 questions divided into three PARTS: I, II, III
2. PART I comprises question numbers 1 to 5 Performing Arts (22 marks).

6. You will require drawing paper, crayons, black ink and an etching tool.

 6. During games time, Grade seven learners were engaged in the following activities:
 i. Climbing ladders
 ii. Throwing and catching bean bags
 iii. Forward and backward rolls
 iv. Handstand
 v. Press ups
 vi. Walking on pranks of wood
 Identify two activities that helped learners to develop coordination skills. (2 marks)

SECTION B Practical (20 marks)
22. This practical should be carried out after completing all the written tasks. Answer
 on a drawing paper.
 Create a still life drawing using the crayon etching technique. Choose a group of objects
 to draw (e.g., fruits, flowers, or household items) and use different colours of crayons to
 fill in the shapes.
 Your work will be judged on the following:
 (i) Creativity
 (ii) Execution skill (crayon application, ink application, etching skill)
 (iii) Composition (use of space,placement of forms; overlapping, size)
 (iv) Neatness & finish
